en: A sepia-toned panoramic view of a town with low buildings, gardens, and a large multi‑storey neoclassical structure on the right, set among hills. The lower half has blank space for correspondence and printing, including a handwritten English note dated April 3rd 1910 and printed captions such as 'Syra, le ...', 'Ποσειδωνία', and a publisher credit. A circular stamp impression appears on the left, and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is overlaid at the bottom right.
